Get parliamentary service periods

Source: R/query-tables.R
get_parl_service.Rd

Reads the parl_service table, or the v_parl_service_display view with display = TRUE: one row per service period. Who held which seat, and when.

Usage

get_parl_service(
  PHID = NULL,
  MemberOrSenator = NULL,
  Electorate = NULL,
  DateStart = NULL,
  DateEnd = NULL,
  Description = NULL,
  handbook_flag = NULL,
  electorate_id = NULL,
  DateEnd_status = NULL,
  ...,
  active_during = NULL,
  display = FALSE,
  columns = NULL,
  collect = TRUE,
  limit = NULL
)

Arguments

PHID

Filter on column PHID (VARCHAR).

MemberOrSenator

Filter on column MemberOrSenator (VARCHAR).

Electorate

Filter on column Electorate (VARCHAR).

DateStart

Filter on column DateStart (DATE).

DateEnd

Filter on column DateEnd (DATE).

Description

Filter on column Description (VARCHAR).

handbook_flag

Filter on column handbook_flag (VARCHAR).

electorate_id

Filter on column electorate_id (INTEGER).

DateEnd_status

Filter on column DateEnd_status (VARCHAR).

...

Must be empty. It forces the arguments after it to be named.

active_during

Keep rows whose period overlaps this: a year, a date (Date or "YYYY-MM-DD"), or an in_range() of years or dates. The period runs from DateStart to DateEnd; a missing DateEnd means it is ongoing. NULL (the default) applies no date filter.

display

If TRUE, read the v_parl_service_display view, which adds display columns to the table's own. Filters still apply.

columns

Character vector of columns to return; NULL returns all.

collect

If TRUE (the default), return a tibble; if FALSE, a lazy table for further dplyr work.

limit

Maximum number of rows to return, or NULL for no limit.

Value

A tibble with one row per service period and every column of parl_service (or of v_parl_service_display) (zero rows if nothing matches), or a lazy table if collect = FALSE.

Details

Every column except content and *_raw columns is a filter argument, spelt as in the database. Each takes NULL (no filter, the default), a vector of values to match, in_range() for an inclusive range, or matches_pattern() for a case-insensitive pattern. Filters combine with AND. Stored values are returned unchanged, and no other filter is applied.

Generated from the database catalog by data-raw/generate-getters.R; for tables without a getter use db_tbl().

See also

in_range(), matches_pattern(), db_tbl()

Examples

db_connect(sample = TRUE)
get_parl_service(MemberOrSenator = "Senator", active_during = 1996)
